scope: Three Route-A incremental read-lane registry-allocation and lossless pre-R2 merge. No production-top instance, R2/core-arbiter connection, R1 launch, response deposit, source delivery, scoreboard event, physical-memory, timing, throughput, PPA, numeric RTL, model/GPU, or new A4 DSE behavior.

excluded_common_lane.name: s2_full
excluded_common_lane.reason: existing common Full-KV source infrastructure is outside Route-A incremental activation

modules.name: route_a_read_delivery_context_allocation_bridge
modules.state: per-lane captured candidate/ref/release wait; no association ownership or R2 scheduling

required_invariants: Only pack_read, direct_pending, and s2_packed read-class carriers with a read request kind and nonzero expected fragment count can allocate through the bridge.
Registry acknowledgement must exactly echo class, identity, expected fragment count, and target descriptor before a lane exposes its bound ref.
The merge compares only existing producer ordinal/id fields and preserves its output under ready-low.
A lane remains unavailable until the exact router release is applied to both bridge and registry.
Production top does not instantiate either module in this closure.
